title: Prince Andrew could face parliamentary debate over conduct
summary: Liberal Democrats are exploring options while calling for crown estate and prince to ‘give evidence under oath’ Prince Andrew could face a parliamentary debate on his conduct despite the government so far refusing to allocate time in the House of Commons as the Liberal Democrats indicated they were exploring ways of raising the issue including in an opposition day debate. Andrew is reportedly in “advanced talks” with the king’s representatives over moving out of the 30-room Grade II-listed Royal Lodge at Windsor, despite his ”cast iron” lease running until 2078.
